notes: Three geometries must never be merged in CAD.
OFFICIAL values come from Waveshare size drawing via board.json.
Visible window is PROVISIONAL_CAD_CANDIDATE until project-author review.

oled_upper_radius.notes: Active-area upper corner R2.50 — must be hidden by bezel

oled_active_offset_x.notes: Inset from glass left/right edges (board.json insetFromGlassSides)

oled_active_offset_y.notes: Inset from glass top edge (board.json insetFromGlassTop); bottom inset = physical_h - active_h - top_inset = 3.28

DISPLAY_VISIBLE_WINDOW.description: Maximum practical rectangle inside active area that hides upper R2.50 corners
DISPLAY_VISIBLE_WINDOW.method: Inscribe rectangle in active area with top inset = oled_upper_radius (2.50 mm); full active width; no left/right/bottom inset beyond active bounds
notes: Do NOT freeze until project author reviews.
Lower active area may be further masked by drive/monitor structure (CLAUDE.md §7) — additional bottom overlap is a separate design choice.
Glass R3.7 lies outside the active opening and is covered by monitor bezel once the window stays within active bounds.

bezel_overlap_top.notes: Minimum to hide R2.50; equals oled_upper_radius

bezel_overlap_bottom.notes: Candidate uses full remaining active height; may increase for drive masking

roundingMaskRequirement.rule: Finished monitor must not reveal upper rounded OLED/active geometry
roundingMaskRequirement.evidence: OFFICIAL active upper R2.50 + glass R3.7 from Waveshare size drawing
